{{Recipe}}

'''Asun''' is a Nigerian dish of grilled goat meat in pepper sauce. It is a Yoruba delicacy often found at Nigerian parties.

==Ingredients==
*[[Cookbook:Goat|Goat]] meat, washed and cut into smaller pieces
*Salt
*[[Cookbook:Bouillon Cube|Stock cube]]
* 2 medium-sized [[Cookbook:Onion|onions]]
*Fresh [[Cookbook:Habanero|habanero]] pepper
*[[Cookbook:Bell Pepper|Bell pepper]], chopped
*1 onion, chopped
 
==Procedure==
# Place goat meat in a clean bowl. Add salt and stock cubes, and give a good massage. [[Cookbook:Marinating|Marinate]] for at least 2 hours to properly season the meat.
# Place the marinated goat meat on an electric barbecue [[Cookbook:Grill|grill]] or oven grill. Rub some vegetable oil on the meat.
# Cover the grill, and grill for about 20 minutes. If you are using an oven grill, grill it for about 40 minutes at 180˚C.
# In a [[Cookbook:Food Processor|food processor]], blend the habanero pepper, and onions to a chunky paste.
# Place a pan on medium heat. Add the grilled meat along with about ¾ cup water to introduce moisture. Let cook for about 5–10 minutes.
# Stir in the pepper and onion mixture, and let cook for about 5–7 minutes.
# Add the chopped bell pepper and onion. Combine thoroughly, and add salt to taste.
# Add a tablespoon of vegetable oil, and combine very well. Leave to [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmer]] for about 2 minutes.
# Serve.
